address: 4 Greycoat Place, Westminster, London, SW1P 1SB, United Kingdom
bio: A Grade II-listed former fire station plays host to this smart, warm and colourfully decorated restaurant, which is run with enthusiasm and sincerity by an attentive team. You can choose from an extensive selection of different menus, all of which take their influences from across India as well as from neighbouring countries. The nicely balanced dishes are prepared with skill, care and understanding – such as a particularly good version of the classic Old Delhi butter chicken. The midweek 'Express Lunch' tiffin boxes are a steal.
